name: carm.es
body: Every page has a title, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But all touch targets must be 24px large, or leave sufficient space.
lesson: Make every link and button at least 24 by 24 px, with space between them.
summary: Partial analysis: 19 of 19 linked pages answered with a bot check or a block, so the scores rest mostly on the start page. www.carm.es scores 65 out of 100 (D). 4 checks fail now, 29 are at risk, and 21 pass. Fix first: elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds.

fix.title: Elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds
fix.fix: Darken the text or lighten the background until normal text reaches 4.5:1 and large text 3:1.

fix.title: All touch targets must be 24px large, or leave sufficient space
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 10 elements on /web/pagina?IDCONTENIDO=1&IDTIPO=180, for example #botonBusqueda and button[aria-label="muestraImagen0"]. Impact: serious.
fix.fix: Make tap targets at least 24 by 24 px, or leave that much space around them.

fix.title: Redirects strip campaign parameters
fix.fix: Keep the query string when redirecting (for example $request_uri in nginx, or :splat with query in Netlify).

fix.title: Tracking starts on load and no banner asks first
fix.evidence: No cookie banner appeared. Before any choice, Chromium from an EU address (Belgium) saw Google Ads (2 requests), Google Analytics (1 request), and cookies __Secure-YNID on youtube.com, YSC on youtube.com, VISITOR_INFO1_LIVE on youtube.com,…
fix.fix: Hold every tag until consent, or set Google Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied before any tag loads. Block third-party embeds until the visitor agrees.

fix.title: 7 cookies are sent without Secure
fix.evidence: Without Secure: __uzma, __uzmb, __uzme, __uzmc and 3 more. Set on /web/pagina?IDCONTENIDO=1&IDTIPO=180.
fix.fix: Set Secure on every cookie, and HttpOnly plus SameSite=Lax on session cookies.

fix.title: 25 resources fail to load
fix.fix: Fix or remove the broken references.

works.title: AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http redirects permanently to https
The largest element paints in 1.4 s
Every page has a meta description
The start page sets a mobile viewport
